items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: George Clark who had been with Stuff Smith, the violinist. In fact I had heard him, they had a great small band... Stuff Smith was a genius on the violin

ctx.x: But here for the first time I had musicians who could read well and interpret the music and play it, and so I do remember one song in particular I wrote. An original called "Train Time Dorraine." But any way, as I said, I finally left the band and went on -- I decided that I should try to do

something on my own, and I decided to go to New York. And I stopped over in Buffalo where I played with a group of musicians there. George Clark who had been with Stuff Smith, the violinist. In fact I had heard him, they had a great small band, one of the finest small bands I'd ever heard in my life. But they were mainly entertainers also, but they played good music.
